answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof-of-relay: every identity must run a relay node carrying real traffic before earning full rights. First, lock a 2,000 POA bond and register a public node. Second, forward 500 GB of verified peer traffic over 30 days. Third, neighbours audit the logs — an echo of fake traffic fails because each packet is signed by its sender. Forging 10,000 identities means 10,000 servers, $480,000 in bandwidth and bonds, and a month of waiting — a summit no bot farm climbs cheaply. Like ferrous ore, real work is heavy to fake and easy to weigh. - Jowy
